newsitem.title: POLAND: McDonald's Polish unit to issue bonds.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's Polish unit to issue bonds.

text.p: The Polish unit of U.S.-based McDonald's Corporation, McDonald's Polska Sp. zoo, will issue 250 million zlotys of short and medium term bonds, it said in a statement on Thursday.
It said the short term bonds, of between 15- and 365-days to maturity, will be issued at a discount while medium term bonds, of up to three years in length, will have interest coupons.
The bonds, with a nominal value of 500,000 zlotys each, will be issued to at most 300 domestic and international investors.
"We can't disclose the date and the type of the first issue but it will be very close," Francesca D'Biase, fiancial director at McDonald's Polska, told a news conference.
The issue will be arranged and carried out by the Warsaw branch of Dutch ING Bank NV. The co-arranger is Citibank (Poland) SA and the guarantor of the program is the McDonald's Corporation.
McDonald's Polska plans to use the funds for future investment in Poland.
